title: Monitorability Score Combining Faithfulness and Verbosity

original_idea.body: Monitorability Score Combining Faithfulness and Verbosity. Problem: no simple composite tool computes a single monitorability score combining a faithfulness probe and a verbosity/coverage measure. Direction: combine a faithfulness flag and a coverage measure per item, produce a per-model monitorability index, analyze the faithfulness-vs-verbosity tradeoff.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: a composite monitorability index targets the property safety teams want from CoT.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused composite-index deliverable; depends on two sub-measures.

novelty.reasoning: Recent work already decomposes monitorability into these two axes; composite index is largely an extension.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: The faithfulness+verbosity decomposition is published; a composite index is incremental.
